description: The judge puts questions to one or both sides (stage JUDGE_QUESTIONS). The sides named in addressedTo answer in the next stage. To proceed without questions, use conclude_stage. Needs your API key.

addressedTo.description: The sides that must answer: ["PLAINTIFF"], ["DEFENCE"] or both.

caseId.description: The case number (OC-0001) or case ID (case_…).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: put_questions
title: Put questions to the parties
